before.endpointStubPolicy: Core paths trim exactly 24 world pixels from each end; full-path metrics retain all endpoint stubs. Crossings between shared-endpoint edge pairs are reported separately.
before.proximityPolicy: Collinear tolerance 0.5 world px; near-parallel excludes collinear and requires >=24 world px longitudinal overlap; measured at both <12 and <20 world px separation.

after.endpointStubPolicy: Core paths trim exactly 24 world pixels from each end; full-path metrics retain all endpoint stubs. Crossings between shared-endpoint edge pairs are reported separately.
after.proximityPolicy: Collinear tolerance 0.5 world px; near-parallel excludes collinear and requires >=24 world px longitudinal overlap; measured at both <12 and <20 world px separation.

checks.name: Fit zoom does not fall by more than 20%

quality.crossingDefinition: Proper segment-interior intersections, counted separately for non-shared-endpoint edge pairs and shared-endpoint pairs; total is their sum. Distinct crossing edge-pair counts remain reported and are not substituted for intersection counts.

tradeoffs: corePaths: distinct non-shared-endpoint crossing edge pairs increased 261 → 262, while proper intersection counts are assessed separately.
